items.label: Capture the Work path, owner repository, role, phase, checklist, evidence target, risks, unknown state, and automatic return path.
items.evidenceTarget: The WYSIWYG gate decision record identifies Project Control ownership and lane boundaries before writing the decision.
items.verificationNote: Identified Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > flowdoc-frontend-expert-roadmap > flowdoc-frontend-product-map > flowdoc-wysiwyg-gate-decision, owner repo-project-control, active role planning-partner with project-control-steward, documentation-authority-steward, and cross-repo boundary review responsibilities, phase target phase-flowdoc-wysiwyg-gate-decision-v1, checklist target checklist-flowdoc-wysiwyg-gate-decision-v1, and evidence target evidence-flowdoc-wysiwyg-gate-decision-2026-09-03.

items.label: Write a failing Project Control guard before adding the WYSIWYG gate decision records.
items.evidenceTarget: A focused test fails before Project Control contains the WYSIWYG gate Work, document, checklist, and evidence records.
items.verificationNote: RED evidence: npx vitest run tests/flowdoc-wysiwyg-gate-decision.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 failed because flowdoc-frontend-product-map did not yet include flowdoc-wysiwyg-gate-decision as a child Work.

items.label: Review existing WYSIWYG, contenteditable, rich-inline, and authoring boundary evidence before writing the decision.
items.evidenceTarget: The decision preserves existing bounded Editor and Core WYSIWYG boundaries instead of replacing them with broader claims.
items.verificationNote: Reviewed evidence-editor-wysiwyg-gate-definition-2026-08-31, docs/versions/V0_1_0a_1/core/template-builder/wysiwyg-draft-input-and-guards.md, docs/versions/V0_1_0a_1/core/template-builder/rich-inline-commit-and-session-lifecycle.md, and related Core evidence records.

items.label: Define the closed WYSIWYG gate and the allowed progressive authoring direction.
items.evidenceTarget: The decision states that the WYSIWYG gate remains closed while managed editable cards and bounded text islands are the allowed direction for later lanes.
items.verificationNote: docs/domains/flowdoc-wysiwyg-gate-decision-2026-09-03.md defines WYSIWYG, Managed Editable Cards, Bounded Text Islands, Contenteditable Shortcuts, and Rich Editor Package Adoption.

items.label: Record prerequisite gates for data model, selection, measurement, save, undo/redo, preview, compatibility, accessibility, and evidence.
items.evidenceTarget: The decision names the prerequisites that must be accepted before later product lanes may claim WYSIWYG or direct page editing behavior.
items.verificationNote: The Prerequisite Checklist requires accepted evidence for data model, selection, measurement, save, undo/redo, preview, compatibility, accessibility, and Project Control evidence packets.

items.label: Block unsupported contenteditable shortcuts, broad direct page editing, and rich editor package adoption.
items.evidenceTarget: The decision keeps unsupported direct editing shortcuts unavailable unless a later Contract Change Request is accepted.
items.verificationNote: The decision blocks full-document contenteditable, direct preview typing, DOM innerHTML document truth, hidden contenteditable shortcuts, table/cell surface editing, media surface editing, drag-to-edit layout mutation, broad clipboard rich-paste behavior, and rich editor engines such as Slate, ProseMirror, and TipTap-style packages.

items.label: Preserve planning-only truth boundaries and avoid product or map truth promotion.
items.evidenceTarget: The decision does not promote frontend readiness, WYSIWYG readiness, publish readiness, production readiness, compatibility, FlowDoc product truth, or map truth.
items.verificationNote: The document states that the decision is planning context, not product truth; it leaves product repository files unchanged and does not update DOCUMENT_MAP or the FlowDoc system map.

items.label: Verify Project Control records, generated read model, and checks.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused WYSIWYG gate guard, generated read model, Project Control data validation, and full Project Control checks pass.
items.verificationNote: GREEN evidence target: npx vitest run tests/flowdoc-wysiwyg-gate-decision.test.ts --maxWorkers=1, npm run generate, npm run check:data, and npm run check.
